content.text: {"class": "INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "reasoning": "The only evidence is a bare assertion message showing 100.00 expected versus 99.99 found, with no contract, release notes, test history, request/response or test code. Per the PRODUCT_DEFECT exclusion, a disagreement where the test's own expectation is the sole statement of what is correct cannot reach PRODUCT_DEFECT, and nothing here distinguishes a miscalculating product from a stale or wrong expected value (or a bad seeded fixture). The deciding evidence would be an independent statement of the correct total — a pricing contract/spec or test history showing the test passed unedited on a prior build."}
